fonts.scope: pinned six distinct JP faces plus mono and explicit symbol fallback; broad cmap subset, actual emitted glyph coverage/loaded/metrics audit pending

faces.label: Noto Sans Mono CJK JP Regular

provenance.licenceAssembly: M PLUS copyright/name13 from original font plus standard SIL OFL 1.1 body

limitations: 準備中です。撮影・最終確認は未実施です。 / Draft: capture and final review are pending.
背景の反復は元の動きのままです。円内で薄くする処理は018待ちです。 / Background repeats keep their original motion; circle fading awaits 018.
今回はカメラとシークが対象です。残像・長い残留・背景や前景の動画は含みません。 / This sample covers camera movement and seeking; trails, long retention and background/foreground video are not included.
変更後のneonは光の広がり方に差があります。 / The glow spread differs in neon after.
一部の拡縮文字は輪郭の滑らかさが変わる場合があります。 / Some scaling letters may have different edge smoothness.

focus.ja: 落下する先頭字・後続の軌跡・着地した主歌詞の対応
focus.en: Falling lead glyphs, delivery trails and their final lyric positions

intent.ja: 文字が落ちて定位置に収まる動きと、円との位置関係を見てください。
intent.en: Watch the falling letters settle and compare their position around the circle.

preserve.ja: 読む順と背景模様の動きを保ちます。拡大・縮小する文字は、輪郭の滑らかさが変わる場合があります。円に収めるため文字サイズを調整する場合があります。拡大・縮小する動きと、そのタイミングを保ちます。
preserve.en: Reading order and background motion are retained. Scaling letters may have different edge smoothness. Text size may be adjusted to fit around the circle. The scaling motion and its timing are retained.

focus.ja: 吊り札・文字・紐・支点・レールのつながり
focus.en: Connections between lyric tags, strings, pins and rail

intent.ja: 所有部材を含む吊り札のまとまりが円を避けるか確認
intent.en: Check that the tag composition and owned attachments avoid the circle

preserve.ja: 札内の文字、揺れ、支点の対応と読む順を保つ
preserve.en: Preserve tag-to-glyph attachment, swing phase, anchors and reading order.

focus.ja: 中央の主歌詞と全画面の遠近線・周縁文字の違い
focus.en: Central lyric versus full-stage perspective rails and perimeter glyphs

intent.ja: トンネル全体を小矩形に縮めず中央の主歌詞を回避するか確認
intent.en: Check central-lyric avoidance while retaining full-stage tunnel perspective

preserve.ja: 遠近線と周縁の反復軌道を保つ。周縁文字の円マスクは018待ち
preserve.en: Preserve rails and perimeter repetition paths; perimeter masking awaits 018.

focus.ja: 中央主歌詞と周囲の反復単語の役割
focus.en: Central lyric and surrounding decorative word copies

intent.ja: 中央主歌詞の配置を円外に構成するか確認
intent.en: Check candidate placement of the central lyric outside the circle

preserve.ja: 全画面の雲状配置と補助語の動きを保つ。補助円マスクは018待ち
preserve.en: Preserve full-stage cloud arrangement and auxiliary motion; auxiliary masking awaits 018.

focus.ja: 跳ねる各文字と地面の線・点・影
focus.en: Bouncing glyphs and their baseline, dots and ground shadows

intent.ja: 文字と所有する地面表現が一緒に回避するか確認
intent.en: Check joint avoidance of glyphs and their owned ground elements

preserve.ja: 字順、跳躍の位相、影が文字の下にある関係を保つ
preserve.en: Preserve reading order, bounce phase and shadows below their glyphs.

focus.ja: 3200×1080での弾性軸と文字・付属線の関係
focus.en: Elastic axis, glyphs and attached strokes at 3200×1080

intent.ja: 弾性軸を保つ文字組の回避構成を確認
intent.en: Check avoidance composition while preserving the elastic axis

preserve.ja: 文字をばらばらに移さず、伸縮方向と部材の連結を保つ
preserve.en: Preserve stretching direction and attachment; do not scatter individual glyphs.

focus.ja: 中央主歌詞と交差する背景帯・反復文字
focus.en: Main lyric versus crossing background bands and repeated glyphs

intent.ja: 主歌詞の回避と背景帯の役割の分離を確認
intent.en: Check main-lyric avoidance separately from background-band roles

preserve.ja: 背景帯と補助反復の軌道は保つ。補助円マスクは018待ち
preserve.en: Preserve background-band and auxiliary repetition paths; auxiliary masking awaits 018.

focus.ja: 3200×1080のステッカー板とその中の各文字
focus.en: Sticker plates and their glyphs at 3200×1080

intent.ja: 板と文字を所有単位で再配置して円を避けるか確認
intent.en: Check avoidance by moving plate-and-glyph ownership groups

preserve.ja: 元の文字数、読む順、板と文字の対応を保つ
preserve.en: Preserve glyph count, reading order and plate-to-glyph correspondence.

focus.ja: 文字と枠の動き、周りに広がる光
focus.en: Moving letters, frame and surrounding glow

intent.ja: 変更後は、円の外に収まるよう発光の描き方を変えています。文字と枠の動きを見てください。
intent.en: After changes how the glow is drawn to fit outside the circle. Watch the letters and frame move.

preserve.ja: 文字と枠、発光の印象を保ちます。光の広がり方には差があります。
preserve.en: The letters, frame and glowing impression are retained. The spread of light differs.

focus.ja: キーの字・凡例・板の対応
focus.en: Key glyphs, legends and their plate

intent.ja: 文字とキーの板が一緒に円を避ける動きを見てください。
intent.en: Watch the letters and key plates move together around the circle.

preserve.ja: キーの並びと、文字と板のつながりを保ちます。拡大・縮小する文字は、輪郭の滑らかさが変わる場合があります。円に収めるため文字サイズを調整する場合があります。拡大・縮小する動きと、そのタイミングを保ちます。
preserve.en: Key order and the connection between each letter and its plate are retained. Scaling letters may have different edge smoothness. Text size may be adjusted to fit around the circle. The scaling motion and its timing are retained.

focus.ja: 泡ごとの語と丸い所有板
focus.en: Words and their owned bubble plates

intent.ja: 泡と中の言葉が一緒に円を避ける動きを見てください。
intent.en: Watch each bubble and its word move together around the circle.

preserve.ja: 語順と、泡と言葉のつながりを保ちます。拡大・縮小する文字は、輪郭の滑らかさが変わる場合があります。円に収めるため文字サイズを調整する場合があります。拡大・縮小する動きと、そのタイミングを保ちます。
preserve.en: Word order and the connection between each bubble and its word are retained. Scaling letters may have different edge smoothness. Text size may be adjusted to fit around the circle. The scaling motion and its timing are retained.

focus.ja: 回転する列と確定する元の文字
focus.en: Rolling columns and the original glyphs they reveal

intent.ja: 列と確定文字の回避構成を確認
intent.en: Check avoidance of rolling columns and their final glyphs

preserve.ja: 列順・文字数・元のリール時刻を保つ
preserve.en: Preserve column order, glyph count and native reel clocks.

focus.ja: 反転する板と表裏の文字
focus.en: Flipping boards and revealed glyphs

intent.ja: 板と文字を一緒に円外へ構成するか確認
intent.en: Check joint avoidance of boards and glyphs

preserve.ja: 板の順序と元のフラップ開示時刻を保つ
preserve.en: Preserve board order and native flap reveal clocks.

focus.ja: クレジットの歌詞行・ラベル・LINE/TIMEと上昇
focus.en: Credit lyric rows, labels, LINE/TIME fields and scrolling

intent.ja: 元の行時刻を保つ複数レーンの回避構成を確認
intent.en: Check avoidance lanes while retaining native credit-row clocks

preserve.ja: 全有限行とラベルを落とさず、行順と実フォントを保つ
preserve.en: Retain every finite row and label, row order and actual font assignments.

focus.ja: 主歌詞と抜き文字の対、背景の反復
focus.en: Main/knockout lyric pair versus background repetitions

intent.ja: 主歌詞の対を一緒に回避するか確認
intent.en: Check joint avoidance of the main and knockout lyric pair

preserve.ja: 主歌詞の二重表現と背景反復の軌道を保つ。補助円マスクは018待ち
preserve.en: Preserve the main pair and background repetition path; auxiliary masking awaits 018.

focus.ja: 同じ歌詞の上半分と下半分
focus.en: Upper and lower fragments of the same lyric

intent.ja: 上下の文字片を整合したまま円外に構成するか確認
intent.en: Check avoidance while keeping upper/lower lyric fragments coherent

preserve.ja: 両コピー、読み順、元の分割位相を保つ
preserve.en: Preserve both copies, reading order and native split phase.

focus.ja: 大きな縦列と次の列への読み順
focus.en: Large vertical columns and inter-column reading order

intent.ja: 縦列の折り返しを使う回避構成を確認
intent.en: Check avoidance composition using ordered vertical columns

preserve.ja: 元の全文字と列の読み順を保つ
preserve.en: Preserve all source glyphs and column reading order.

focus.ja: LEDセルと文字の出現パターン
focus.en: LED cells and glyph reveal patterns

intent.ja: セル格子の文字組で円を避けるか確認
intent.en: Check avoidance through LED-grid composition

preserve.ja: セル形状、元の文字、開示順を保つ
preserve.en: Preserve cell shapes, source glyphs and reveal order.

focus.ja: 奥行き方向の主歌詞の全コピー
focus.en: All primary lyric copies in the depth stack

intent.ja: 前後に重なる文字の動きと、円との位置関係を見てください。
intent.en: Watch the layered letters move around the circle.

preserve.ja: 重なる文字の数と並ぶ順序を保ちます。拡大・縮小する文字は、輪郭の滑らかさが変わる場合があります。円に収めるため文字サイズを調整する場合があります。拡大・縮小する動きと、そのタイミングを保ちます。
preserve.en: The number and order of the layers are retained. Scaling letters may have different edge smoothness. Text size may be adjusted to fit around the circle. The scaling motion and its timing are retained.

focus.ja: g3の六つの実書体とそのラベル
focus.en: Six actual g3 specimen faces and their labels

intent.ja: 六書体の順序を保つ帯状の回避構成を確認
intent.en: Check ordered specimen-band avoidance for all six faces

preserve.ja: Sans太/標準・Serif太/標準・Rounded・Dotを区別し、全見本を保つ
preserve.en: Retain all specimens and distinct Sans bold/regular, Serif bold/regular, Rounded and Dot faces.

focus.ja: 3200×1080の巨大な「風」と全歌詞の対
focus.en: Oversized focus glyph 風 and complete lyric at 3200×1080

intent.ja: 大きな「風」と歌詞全体の動き、円との位置関係を見てください。
intent.en: Watch the large 風 and the complete lyric move around the circle.

preserve.ja: 大きな一字と歌詞全体の関係を保ちます。拡大・縮小する文字は、輪郭の滑らかさが変わる場合があります。円に収めるため文字サイズを調整する場合があります。拡大・縮小する動きと、そのタイミングを保ちます。
preserve.en: The relationship between the large glyph and the complete lyric is retained. Scaling letters may have different edge smoothness. Text size may be adjusted to fit around the circle. The scaling motion and its timing are retained.

focus.ja: 縦向きの半面構成と元の文字
focus.en: Native vertical half composition and source glyphs

intent.ja: 半面の構成を保つ回避を確認
intent.en: Check avoidance while retaining the vertical-half composition

preserve.ja: 元の向き、全コピーと読む順を保つ
preserve.en: Preserve native orientation, all copies and reading order.

focus.ja: カーテン状の開示と文字のまとまり
focus.en: Curtain-style reveal and lyric composition

intent.ja: 開示位相を保った円回避を確認
intent.en: Check circle avoidance while retaining the reveal phase

preserve.ja: 文字、クリップ形状と開閉の時刻の対応を保つ
preserve.en: Preserve the relationship between glyphs, clip geometry and reveal clocks.

focus.ja: 歌詞とその所有する棒・ブロック・ピーク
focus.en: Lyric glyphs and their owned bars, blocks and peaks

intent.ja: 信号表現を含む行単位の回避構成を確認
intent.en: Check row-level avoidance including owned signal elements

preserve.ja: 元の信号位相と文字・棒の対応を保つ
preserve.en: Preserve native signal phase and glyph-to-bar attachment.

focus.ja: 3200×1080のテープ帯とその文字
focus.en: Tape strips and their lyric glyphs at 3200×1080

intent.ja: 帯と文字の所有関係を保つ円回避を確認
intent.en: Check circle avoidance while keeping tape strips attached to their lyrics

preserve.ja: テープの重なり、端と文字の関係、読む順を保つ
preserve.en: Preserve tape overlap, endpoints, glyph attachment and reading order.
